(make it temporary block)

I have been in many private worlds, where there are always people blocked. It's a nuisance for many people when blocked users talk over each other  or stand inside of each other .  Even this issue can lead to mutes or blocks for talking over their friend.

A solution would be to make a temporary block or remove it . Also alot of people in this game need to learn how to socialize and this block feature is an quick escape from the reality.

Hi Vladimir, excited to see a fellow clinical psychologist on here! I've been using VRChat since nearly its beginning 5 years ago, and unfortunately I have to say I disagree strongly with the idea of removing a blocking feature. While it is true that blocking someone else can become a maladaptive "safety behavior" that maintains anxiety (for example, someone with social anxiety blocking strangers), it's an important safety feature to get rid of trolls. When they added the ability to block, it made the community a safer place. It also created a natural consequence for trolls, and allowed people to stay in a room and feel psychologically safe. 

From my experience, it seems that VRChat as a whole forces people to experience novel social interaction. It would be unrealistic for a person to block every new person they see, and while some people may have a lower threshold for choosing to block, I don't believe it means we should remove this feature.

It would be good to have a short dialog asking the player for 
"how long"  after they block someone 
(I would advice this to happen after the block has been initiated as if someone is being malicious, like crashers, you want someone "gone" as fast as possible)
So the process would be:
Aim--->Player details--->Block
*player poofs away*
When do you want to automatically unblock this player?
1 hour -- 6 hours -- 1 day -- 1 week -- manual
This could be something reflected in the status visible by the blocked person "you have been blocked until 5:59 hrs"

details:
First of all i want to say, that i'm a psychologist working in nursing home specializing in mental health/alzheimer patients/mood swings/recurring fears/persistent gloom/ etc.


There are alot of people in Vrchat who block/mute that have an issue with socializing with unknown people. There are alot of people who aren't sociable or tolerant and they use block to fix their issue. There is also alot of discrimination against lower ranks people, as hardcore vrchat players feel superior to other users.

As a professional  psychologist i can read people very easily, and i almost have been doing tests everyday for a total of 500+ hours.

There are many reasons for a player to use block, and i will explain some of them.

1. Standing too close or staring at an avatar without saying anything - block )  Taking the game too seriously/feeling threatened by another user because of real life social insecurities .

2. Blocking for talking back, ) People who are bad at socializing will get emotional very fast and might feel threatened by somebody who talks back in a normal non threatening calm voice, because they realize they can't win, they just block to fix their issue.

3.Blocking for having a lower rank, ) Heard people say it many time ingame, that they insta block newcomers/newusers. Have been in many rooms with, known/trusted users that felt superior to lower ranks. Have seen people getting kicked for no reason just because they had a lower rank. 
(This superiority sense comes from own real life insecurities that makes a person act like this.)

4. Blocking for being superior at socializing or stealing all the attention , ) People will block easily if they can sense that you're more superior at socializing, as they want to have a sense of control that they don't have in real life.

5. Blocking for own superiority, ) People will block you for very simple reasons to just show you their own superiority over you and to boost their own emotional ego.  (i had people come up to me when i was talking to express that they're gonna block me because of their own bad emotional state/health) They always make sure to show you how they do it, they will stand infront of you and hover their vr hands to block option. Even mute users that never talk, do it all in the same way to express their superiority.

I can go on, hopefully i gave you guys some insights of how i see it from my professional  perspective. The block option needs to get removed, for this game and users benefits.
title: Make a temporary block!!!
